title: Dice Roll Event Integration
goal: Make Dice Engine RollResult the first real durable Event Log consumer without making Dice Engine write events automatically.

include: Call the public Dice Engine facade from an event-log orchestrator
Create one transaction containing one roll.performed event
Append the completed transaction through the durable Event Store
Preserve formula, faces, total, mode and critical metadata in event payload

acceptance: A normal roll can be logged as one durable transaction
Advantage and critical RollResult metadata survive event reload
A d100 roll uses the same public Dice Engine API
Failed event append does not report durable success
Dice Engine remains side-effect free and imports no Event Store code

commands.reason: Focused coverage must prove roll payload validation, durable append and reload behavior.
The repository baseline must remain green after event-log integration.
The final patch must not contain whitespace errors.

manual: Confirm no roll UI, combat behavior or persistent schema migration was introduced.

risk.notes: The task touches durable event append semantics, but it should not mutate page storage or Dice Engine behavior directly.

requiresApproval.reason: Any event storage schema change beyond the approved sidecar format requires owner approval.
Dice UI and combat behavior are outside this leaf and require separate owner direction.

notes: This example is based on a completed Phase 15 leaf and is intended as validator evidence, not as an active roadmap item.
